deterministic_event_key: lowercase hex sha256 of length-delimited canonical material over package_id, event_action, run_id, decision_id, book_id, segment_key, and event_version
canonical_material_encoding: sha256-v1 label followed by |field_name=decimal_length:value for each identity field in fixed order; nulls are prohibited by reviewed-boundary checks
collision_handling: sha256 collision is treated as AUDIT_CONFLICT unless every immutable field and canonical payload also match
rollback_distinction: event_action and before/after statuses differ, so application and rollback event_key values differ
